description:
Regens is collaborative game to gamify Urban Interactions and improve citizen coordination in Bogota public places. Players will be able to take 4 quests in the city to collect public places as NFTs, generate video content related to those places and get rewards.

1. Tourist / Museums, landmarks / [Bogota’s Tourism Office](https://www.bogotadc.travel/)
2. Scholar / Universities, schools / [Secretaria de Educación del Distrito](https://www.educacionbogota.edu.co/portal_institucional/inicio)
3. Biker / Bicycle roads / [Secretaria Distrital de Movilidad](https://www.movilidadbogota.gov.co/)
4. Youth / Public parks, playgrounds, sports courts / [Distrito Joven](https://www.distritojoven.gov.co/)

Collectors sharing the same Quest will be able to participate on governance interactions to identify public needs and create proposals on IRL public goods. All proposals will be shared with the Government offices dedicated to each Quest topic.
Players with a worldcoin ID will be able to boost their rewards.
how_its_made:
This project uses:

* A scaffold ETH + Tailwind template for the dapp
* IPFS for the video storage
* The Graph for index contract interactions
* Optimism for minting and government contracts
* Worldcoin with the WorldID to enable governance proposals creation
* Polygon
